text:
alex: deploy-bot just blocked the staging promotion for payments-service — says dependent chart billing-common has version skew with the promoted chart. Anyone on this?

deploy-bot: promotion blocked by dependency mismatch
service: payments-service
requested-chart: payments-chart v2.4.0
dependencies:
  - name: billing-common  current: v1.9.1  required: >=v2.0.0
action: pause promotion; advise manual pin or bump dependency

priya: looking. quick check — we started the payments split last week so some microservices still reference billing-common v1.x in their values overlays.

alex: ugh. is this the cross-service chart split fallout we worried about?

sarah: yes. payments-chart now depends on billing-common v2 because of the customer-id field rename. If other services in the staged release still bind to v1 it fails the dependency resolver.

matt: what are options? rollback staging? pin payments-chart to previous working combo?

priya: options: 1) patch payments-chart to accept billing-common v1 via templating shim (ugly), 2) pin payments-chart to 2.3.x that uses billing-common v1, 3) bump the other services overlays to v2 of billing-common (fast but riskier), 4) small canary on a subset of namespaces after manual approval.

jen: for velocity I'd do option 2 (pin) for this promotion, then create a follow-up post-merge migration to upgrade dependent overlays. Keeps staging stable.

alex: agrees with pin. can someone prepare the pin and a note in release notes so QA knows the temporary cheat?

priya: I'll prepare a chart override to force payments-chart 2.3.8 for this promotion and open a tiny PR to values-staging: 
```yaml
# override to force old chart for staging-only promotion
charts:
  payments-chart: 2.3.8
  billing-common: 1.9.1
```

priya: will also run the deploy-bot dry-run after PR merge: `./scripts/deploybot promote --env staging --dry-run payments-service`

deploy-bot: note — when you pin like this, the automated release-notes composer will flag a mismatch. Add a manual release-note snippet so changelog generation doesn't drop the dependency reason.

matt: thanks — I'll add a short note: "Temporary pin of payments-chart to 2.3.8 due to billing-common v2 API rename; follow-up upgrade planned (ENG-1451)". Add to release-notes/staging.md?

jen: yep put it in release-notes/staging.md and tag QA: @qa-team. Also mark the pin with an annotation so the releasebot can find it: `release-note: pin-staging-dependency`

alex: timeline? we want staging green before tomorrow morning testing window.

priya: PR in 10m, will run dry-run and post results here. If dry-run shows other hidden deps, we'll escalate to hotfix branch.

deploy-bot: dry-run result: promotion dry-run succeeded with pinned charts. No runtime migrations detected.

alex: sweet. priya, after merge can you trigger the real promote? (no dry-run)

priya: doing it now: `./scripts/deploybot promote --env staging payments-service` 

deploy-bot: promotion started -> logs: pod rollingupdate in payments-staging-1. rollout 35% -> 100% -> success.

matt: QA pinged — they got the note and will run smoke tests in an hour.

jen: follow-up action item: create ENG-1451 and schedule overlay bump across downstream services in next sprint. I'll own release notes cleanup after the upgrade.

alex: thanks team. leaving the pinned chart annotation so releasebot retains the reason. we'll unblock the main promotion path once overlays are updated. :thumbsup:
